class.name: PollenCloud3D
class.brief_description: Pollen shed by dry wind from conifer crowns and flowering grass, drawn as a drifting haze with NVIDIA Flow.
class.description: In early summer, dry wind shakes pollen from conifer crowns (the placed crowns of the scene's [VegetationField3D]s that are needle-leaved) and from the flowering sward (the scene's [GrassField3D]s, where their rules grow grass). Every quarter second this picks the nearest sources round the camera, works out how much each sheds from the weather ([WorldWeather]: air humidity, leaf wetness, rain and the wind at the crown or the sward; conifers in [member conifer_window], grasses by their anthesis in the season) and feeds a pool of sphere emitters in a PhysXFlow3D of its own (0.5 m cells, a faint yellow gas a little heavier than air, carried by the weather's wind). Without the PhysX module's Flow the sources are still worked out and nothing is drawn. [VegetationPollen3D] draws the close puffs a body brushing flowering plants shakes out.

method.name: get_conifer_sources
method.description: The conifer crowns shedding at the last update.

method.name: get_flow
method.description: The PhysXFlow3D drawing the pollen, or [code]null[/code] before the first release or without Flow.

method.name: get_grass_sources
method.description: The sward points shedding at the last update.

method.name: get_release
method.description: The weather's share of a full release at the camera at the last update, times the larger share in flower (0 to 1).

method.name: get_sources
method.description: The sources of the last update, one [Dictionary] each: [code]position[/code], [code]velocity[/code] (the wind there), [code]radius[/code], [code]rate[/code] (0 to 1 of a full release) and [code]conifer[/code].

method.name: has_flow
method.description: Whether the Flow grid was made.

method.name: release_factor
method.description: The weather's share of a full release (0 to 1): dry air (full at 55% relative humidity and under, none over 85%), dry leaves, no rain, and a wind past 3 m/s rising to full at 8 m/s.

method.name: update_sources
method.description: Picks the sources and feeds the emitters now. The node does this every 0.25 s while processing.

method.name: window_share
method.description: The share in flower on a day of the year for a window of days, with 7-day ramps either side.

members.member: The pollen's colour (sulphur yellow, as pine pollen).
The days of the year the conifers flower (an estimate for northern temperate pines and spruces).
The days of the year the grasses flower when the weather gives no season (an estimate).
The most conifer crowns shedding at once, nearest first.
The most sward points shedding at once, nearest first.
How far round the camera crowns shed, in metres (the sward within 30 m of it at most).
The Flow emitter's smoke at a full release.
The terrain the Flow grid rests on (PhysXFlow3D.terrain_path).
